text: Assumption: NmException is thrown primarily when synchronous calls fail or errors from ara::core::Result are explicitly unpacked as an exception — is this correct?

assumption: NmException is thrown primarily when synchronous calls fail or errors from ara::core::Result are explicitly unpacked as an exception.
rationale: The payload verifies NmException as the exception type for API errors and construction via ErrorCode, but does not define any specific trigger guidelines.

original.rationale: Der Payload belegt NmException als Exception-Typ für API-Fehler und die Konstruktion über ErrorCode, definiert aber keine spezifischen Auslöserichtlinien.
